_comment: Single source of truth for the inspector's rule set and its mapping to the 3ricj/FibreSeeker3 issue tracker. Both the engine (src/inspector.js CHECKS) and the report generator (gen_report.js) key off these ids. Keep in sync with CHECKS in src/inspector.js.

rules.title: Un-retracted plastic travel across voids / open air (stringing)
rules.predicate: A plastic (E) travel that immediately follows a plastic extrusion without prior retraction and crosses a void or open air. Hopped crossings are summarised separately because Z-hop does not stop ooze. Also flags retraction written after the travel.

rules.title: Aligned seams — perimeter start points stacked in Z
rules.predicate: The `; SEAM Plastic/Fiber at X.. Y..` marker repeats within a 0.5 mm XY cell for >= minSeamRun consecutive layers.

rules.title: Enclosed gaps wider than the deposited bead
rules.predicate: A layer leaves an enclosed empty region (flood-fill from outside never reaches it) whose inscribed width exceeds gapRatio x the Inset0 bead width and is bounded by a perimeter bead, capped at MAX_GAP_MM so designed openings are excluded.

rules.title: Volumetric flow demand above the material ceiling
rules.predicate: Sustained (>= 1 s continuous) melt demand from E or matrix V feed, converted with filament cross-sectional area and move duration, above the exported profile limit or an explicitly labelled generic fallback. Header wall estimates use the declared wall height where available.
fixtures: src/regression_test.js (independent numerical flow and profile-limit cases)

rules.title: Layer time below the slicer's own minimum
rules.predicate: A layer's summed move time is below Profile.MinLayerTimeForSlowing (falling back to LayerTimeForMaxCooling, then a tool floor, when the profile declares 0).

rules.title: Long unsupported (bridging) printed runs
rules.predicate: A contiguous printed path whose sampled points are >90% unsupported, reported at its completed length once it reaches minUnsupported mm. The run ends at supported plastic, a travel, a feature change or a layer change. Support is age-based: material deposited in that column within the last supportDepth (2) layers, probed over a supportRadius (0.4 mm) disc, excluding the layer being printed. Support/skirt/brim/priming/wipe excluded; plastic only.

rules.title: Implicit motion contract — accel/jerk/max-feedrate not declared
rules.predicate: No M204 (accel), or first M204 past line 200, or no M205 (jerk), or no M203 (max feedrate); Klipper motion limits present only as a header echo, not executable lines.

rules.title: Fiber-feed window commands M1001/M1002 unimplemented in firmware
rules.predicate: Any M1001/M1002 emitted (no firmware handler exists); M1002 without a matching M1001; M1001 with no L parameter; unclosed M1001 windows.

rules.title: Slicer/firmware command contract — undefined verbs
rules.predicate: A verb outside the documented dialect is emitted (e.g. CASE_FAN, SET_FAN_AT_LAYER); CASE_FAN referenced by exported start/end gcode; start gcode reads toolhead_temp where a chamber reading is expected (issue #10).

rules.title: Plastic travel Z-hop emitted against the exported DoZHop setting
rules.predicate: A plastic travel Z-hop (up ZhopP then back to the same Z within a travel, last extrusion axis E) is emitted while the SESSION echo reports Profile.DoZHop=false.

rules.title: Geometry / parse sanity
rules.predicate: Deposited geometry leaves the declared build area; no extrusion moves parsed; no ; LAYER: markers parsed; header LAYER_COUNT disagrees with parsed layer markers; relative-XYZ (G91) in an absolute-XYZ dialect.

rules.title: Carbon fibre on the first layer of a non-fortified print
rules.owner_rule: Owner request 2026-10-03: "Unless it's a fortified print - carbon should not be the first layer."
rules.predicate: Positive `U` deposition on layer 1 inside a part-geometry feature (anything other than Skirt/Brim/Priming line/Wipe tower) while the SESSION echo shows the print is not fortified. Fortified = `CurrentSliceType == 2` (Composite Only) or `Profile.MustGenerateFiberPerimeters == true`, i.e. the fibre is the part's own skin and must start at the bed. A first-layer fibre pass confined to the sacrificial priming/skirt is reported as info, not a violation.

rules.title: Tool configuration — dual-tool (FFF + CFC) vs single-tool FFF
rules.owner_rule: Owner request 2026-10-03: "Report on if it's a dual tool or single tool (FFF) print."
rules.predicate: Verdict derived from observed deposition (plastic `E` > 0 and/or fibre `U` > 0) plus the `T0`/`T1` counts, then cross-checked against the `; PRINTING_MODE:` header. A header that contradicts observed deposition is a warning, except `Composite Only` with plastic present, which is the documented wet-out/tool-change quirk and is reported as info.
fixtures: single-tool FFF: Benchy_speedy_default_settings*.gcode, the Tinmorry sample

rules.title: Total fibre consumed and number of cuts
rules.owner_rule: Owner request 2026-10-03: "Report on total length of fibre used, number of cuts". (Cuts were previously only visible as the raw M1001/M1002 count; the M2800 blade count and the trimmed tail are now reported directly.)
rules.predicate: Fibre is reported in three separated quantities: fed = every positive `U` word; deposited = positive `U` on a move with XY motion; restart = positive `U` with no XY motion (the `G1 F1200 U55 ; Extrude restart` air prime). Cuts = `M2800` count, with the `;CUT DISTANCE` sum and the constant tail length. Deposited is cross-checked against the `MATERIAL_PRINT_DATA` tow `Length` (agrees to 6 significant digits corpus-wide) and the cut count against the `M1001` segment count.
fixtures: Benchy_fortified.gcode (78.91 m fed / 63.51 m deposited / 280 cuts)
Benchy_renforced_level5.gcode (15.94 m fed / 10.16 m deposited / 105 cuts)

rules.title: Machine-assist flags — presence or absence
rules.owner_rule: Owner request 2026-10-03: "check for the presence of the machine flags (AI detection, bed leveling, etc settings), or the absence of them."
rules.predicate: Each flag in `Dialect.MACHINE_FLAGS` (homing G28, bed mesh/auto-leveling, Z probe & Z-offset, AI/spaghetti detection, filament runout/motion sensor, resonance/input shaper, power-loss recovery, crash detection, pause/cancel-on-failure) is searched for in the *command* text of every non-comment line, never in a comment, so a header echo can never count as presence. Absence is reported explicitly with the list of what was not found.
fixtures: all 11 files — every flag absent; no fixture exercises the present branch

punts.title: Documentation improvement
punts.reason: Asks for clearer bed-leveling / first-layer-troubleshooting documentation and companion videos. No G-code artifact to inspect.

punts.title: No cleaning of the left head during prints
punts.reason: Closed. The defect and its fix live in Klipper tool_switch.cfg / cleaning-station macros, not in the emitted G-code. The tool inspects sliced files, not printer firmware config.

punts.title: Fan schedule not machine-readable
punts.reason: Closed. The per-layer fan plan living only in the header echo is observable (SET_FAN_AT_LAYER is flagged as an undefined verb by C09), but the issue is a slicer feature request, not a defect the tool adjudicates.
